QuestInfo.name: [Elodin] Spring Cleaning
QuestInfo.0: Now that you've collected plenty of Hay, ask #b#p1501001##k what to do with it.
QuestInfo.1:
#b#p1501001##k handed you a broomstick and asked you to help clean like you're some kind of maid! Ugh! Sweep away those evil Dust Bundles with the #bMakeshift Broomsticks#k in #b#m101082300##k.

If you've used up all the #bMakeshift Broomsticks#k, you can make more with #rHay#k from #rHay Bundles#k.
QuestInfo.2: You kicked those Dust Bundles to the curb! Talk to #b#p1501001##k again.

0.conditionContent: Eliminate Dust Bundles with the Makeshift Broomstick

0.msg: All right, start weaving that hay!

3.msg: I asked you to help clean, didn't I?

0.msg: Make sure you have enough Makeshift Broomsticks in your possession, then eliminate Dust Bundles to clean the place up.\r\n#rYou can only eliminate 10 monsters per broom. If you're short on Makeshift Broomsticks, you can make more with Hay from Hay Bundles!
What? If you're going to help, do it right!
I knew you were the right person for the job! You're quick!
